prompt:
Create a 3x1 sprite sheet for a modern 16-bit-style pixel-art RPG: one MONSTER in three battle poses.

Image 1 is a LAYOUT GUIDE: three cells on white. In each cell the light-grey box shows where the monster stands and how big it is, the grey line is the ground, and the arrow shows the facing: the monster faces RIGHT, toward the heroes. Draw the SAME monster once in every cell, filling its box. Never draw the grey box, line or arrow.

Image 2 is the HOUSE STYLE: an approved hero sprite sheet from this same game. Match its sprite-pixel size, black outlines, flat shading with 2-3 tones per colour and level of detail exactly, but do NOT copy the hero; it is a different character.

Image 3 is an APPROVED MONSTER sheet from this same game (a DIFFERENT monster, idle | attack | hurt): match its sprite-pixel size, rendering, shading, outline weight and level of detail, and how much the poses move. Do NOT copy that monster's body, colours or equipment.

Render as true pixel art: the monster about 96-120 pixels tall in sprite pixels, every sprite pixel a hard-edged square, no anti-aliasing, no gradients.

Monster: a gaunt, otherworldly horse from another plane, seen from the side: an ash-grey hide stretched tight over a bony frame, a ridge of short bone spines along the neck and the back, deep cracks across the flanks and neck glowing a sickly yellow-green from inside, a long narrow skull-like head with two burning yellow-green eyes, a mane and tail of drifting black smoke edged with small yellow-green embers (drawn as part of the body, with dark outlines), thin long legs ending in dark iron hooves; the whole horse, tail tip to muzzle, sits in the middle of its own cell with empty space on both sides; palette of ash grey, charcoal, bone white and sickly yellow-green. Keep every detail identical in every cell. FACE: the narrow skull-like head with two burning yellow-green eyes, each a clear bright spot, is readable.

Cells:
- left cell: idle, a ready battle stance facing right.
- middle cell: attack, a lunging strike toward the heroes: the head thrust forward and down with the long jaw open, the forelegs lifted only a little and striking forward, the hind hooves on the ground, the smoke mane streaming back close to the neck; no rearing up; the whole horse well inside the middle cell, facing right.
- right cell: hurt, knocked back, all four hooves on the ground, the head tossed up a little, the glowing cracks flaring brighter, one foreleg buckling; no taller than its idle height, recoiling away from the heroes (leaning left), still facing right.

MOVEMENT: the attack and hurt cells are dramatic ACTION frames, not static stances. Use a clear diagonal line of action through the whole body but keep the hind hooves on the ground and the body low (no leap, no rearing up): thrust the head toward the heroes with the neck bent so the head stays well inside its own cell; the smoke mane and tail move with the motion, kept close to the body. Each of the three silhouettes must be clearly different. BODY: in every cell, standing on four legs seen from the side, every paw on the ground line unless it is lifted to strike or rear. No mist, smoke or ground effects.

One monster per cell and nothing else: no props on the ground, no effects outside the monster, no text.
Background: solid flat magenta (#FF00FF) everywhere, no floor, no shadows, no borders.
Avoid: two creatures in one cell, different creatures in different cells, background scenery, floor tiles, shadows on the ground, magic effects outside the cell, text, frame, border, grid lines, blurry, soft shading, gradient, 3d render, a rider, a saddle, a bridle, white or brown patches, a horn, wings, blue fire, violet, purple, pink, magenta, rearing up.
